526:   private def navigate(value: JsonValue, parts: List[String]): Option[JsonValue] =
527:     parts match {
528:       case Nil      => Some(value)
529:       case h :: rest =>

533:           case JArray(items) if h.forall(_.isDigit) =>
534:             val idx = h.toInt

551: /**
552:  * Basic tokenizer that splits text on whitespace and applies optional
553:  * normalisation rules. Used for NLP-style processing pipelines.
554:  */
555: final class WhitespaceTokenizer(
556:     val lowercase: Boolean = false,
557:     val minLength: Int = 0,
558:     val maxLength: Option[Int] = None,
559:     val stripPunctuation: Boolean = false
560: ) {
561: 
562:   private val punctuation: Set[Char] = Set(' ', ',', '.', '!', '?', ';', ':',
563:     '\'', '"', '(', ')', '[', ']', '{', '}').filterNot(_.isWhitespace) -- Set(' ')
564:   private val punctuationString: String = punctuation.mkString
565: 
566:   /** Process a single word into an optional token string. */
567:   def processToken(word: String): Option[String] = {
568:     val stripped =
569:       if (stripPunctuation) stripPunctuationFrom(word) else word
570: 
571:     val normalised =
572:       if (lowercase) stripped.toLowerCase
573:       else stripped
574: 
575:     if (normalised.length < minLength) None
576:     else maxLength match {
577:       case Some(max) if normalised.length > max =>
578:         Some(normalised.take(max))
579:       case _ =>
580:         if (normalised.isEmpty) None else Some(normalised)
581:     }
582:   }
583: 
584:   /** Strip leading/trailing characters in [[punctuation]] from a word. */
585:   private def stripPunctuationFrom(word: String): String = {
586:     var start = 0
587:     var end   = word.length
588:     while (start < end && punctuation.contains(word.charAt(start))) start += 1
589:     while (end > start && punctuation.contains(word.charAt(end - 1))) end -= 1
590:     if (start >= end) "" else word.substring(start, end)
591:   }
592: 
593:   /** Split text by whitespace and return a list of tokens. */
594:   def tokenize(text: String): List[Token] = {
595:     val words = text.split("\\s+").toList.filter(_.nonEmpty)
596:     words.zipWithIndex.collect {
597:       case (word, i) =>
598:         processToken(word).map { processed =>
599:           Token(processed, TokenType.STRING, Map("position" -> i, "original" -> word))
600:         }
601:     }.flatten
602:   }
603: 
604:   /** Split text by whitespace and return only the token values. */
605:   def tokenizeToStrings(text: String): List[String] =
606:     tokenize(text).map(_.value)
607: 
608:   /** Tokenize text and return (token, start, end) character positions. */
609:   def tokenizeWithPositions(text: String): List[(String, Int, Int)] = {
610:     val words = text.split("\\s+").toList.filter(_.nonEmpty)
611:     var cursor = 0
612:     val out = ListBuffer.empty[(String, Int, Int)]
613:     words.foreach { word =>
614:       val start = text.indexOf(word, cursor)
615:       if (start >= 0) {
616:         val end = start + word.length
617:         processToken(word).foreach(processed => out += ((processed, start, end)))
618:         cursor = end
619:       } else {
620:         cursor += word.length
621:       }
622:     }
623:     out.toList
624:   }
625: 
626:   /** Number of tokens in the text. */
627:   def countTokens(text: String): Int = tokenize(text).length
628: }
